name: Quantum Optics Jena
description: Quantum Optics Jena develops entanglement-based quantum key distribution systems for secure communications. Spun off from the Fraunhofer Institute for Applied Optics and Fine Mechanics (IOF), the company offers the world's first commercial multi-party QKD system, serving government networks, banks, and research institutions.

products.name: Multi-Party QKD System
products.description: World's first commercial entanglement-based multi-party quantum key distribution system for securing network communications

highlights: Spun off from Fraunhofer IOF with deep expertise in applied optics and entangled photon sources
Offers the world's first commercial multi-party QKD system serving government and banking networks
Secured EUR 8.5M+ in Series A funding to scale quantum-secure communication deployments

sources.title: Quantum Optics Jena Secures EUR 8.5 Million in Series A Funding — bm|t

news.title: Quantum Optics Jena Secures €8.5 Million in Series A Funding to Revolutionize Secure Communications
news.excerpt: Quantum Optics Jena announced the closing of an €8.5 million Series A funding round led by Join Capital, with early investors ELAS Technologies GmbH, Fraunhofer Technologies-Transfer Fonds, and beteiligungsmanagement Thüringen (bm|t) as well as business angel Malte Pollmann. The funding will fuel expansion and accelerate commercialization of its quantum key distribution technology.
